q: Is a heat pump dryer lower carbon than an LPG dryer?
title: Heat pump dryer vs LPG dryer
short: Often, because a heat pump moves heat rather than making it, and it recovers moisture-laden heat that an LPG dryer vents. On the Indian grid the answer depends on how much heat it delivers per kWh. Compare kg CO2 per kg of water removed: LPG at 2.98 kg CO2 per kg, electricity at 0.710 per kWh.
audience: Food, spice, herb and textile dryers

ul: Measure water removed per batch: weight in minus weight out.
LPG kg or kWh per batch from invoices or a meter.
Divide emissions by kg of water removed.
Drying temperature: heat pumps suit low and medium temperatures.
Rooftop solar powering the heat pump.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
